Job Description:
About Harver

Harver delivers a suite of automated solutions that optimize talent decisions for some of the world's leading organizations. Rooted in over 40 years of science and rich data insights backed by industrial-organizational and cognitive science, we enable organizations to engage, hire, and grow the right talent in a fast and fundamentally unbiased way.

Our Employee Value Proposition

Putting the right person in the right role is life-changing — for the individual and for the organization. That's not a tagline. It's the reason we come to work. We've applied 35 years of assessment science to one of the hardest problems in business, helping thousands of organizations hire with more confidence and less guesswork. Now we're entering our most exciting chapter yet — new products, a sharpened focus, and a market that genuinely needs what we've built.

The people here are something else. Smart, authentic, genuinely invested in the work and in each other. This isn't a place where you coast — you'll be pushed and expected to deliver. But you'll do it alongside people who care, led by a vision that's worth working hard for.

If that sounds like your kind of place, we'd love to meet you.

Job Overview

Everything Harver builds exists to help our customers achieve a greater Return on Talent Investment — putting the right person in the right role through science-backed, skills-based hiring. That promise only holds if the platforms behind it are dependable, and that's the quality bar you'll own. As our QA Manager, you'll be the most senior quality voice at Harver, accountable for the quality of every platform we support and for the QA Engineers who protect each one.

This is a builder's role, not a gatekeeper's. You'll set the quality strategy across our platforms, shape how quality is designed into products from discovery onward, and lead a team of platform-focused QA Engineers — coaching them, setting direction, and raising the ceiling on what good looks like. You'll be as comfortable authoring acceptance criteria and reviewing test architecture as you are running a 1:1 or making the call on an escalation. You know automation deeply (Playwright, Node.js, TypeScript, MongoDB, Postgres) and are fluent with AI-assisted engineering — Claude Code, agents, and skills — and you use that fluency to build systems and standards that scale, not to become the bottleneck.

If you're passionate about working in a dynamic, fast-growing company — with cutting edge technology, smart colleagues, and opportunities for development — come grow with us!

Responsibilities And Qualifications

In this role you get to:

Own quality across every platform Harver supports — set the strategy, define what "healthy" looks like for each platform, and hold a continuously current view of quality and a standing plan for how to improve it. 
Lead and grow the QA function — manage the QA Engineers responsible for each platform, coach and develop them, set clear direction, and build a high-performing, high-trust team. 
Shift quality left — bring QA into discovery by default, so quality risks, edge cases, and acceptance expectations are shaped before engineering takes ownership rather than discovered late. 
Own acceptance criteria and test contracts as the backbone of quality — ensure stories reach engineering with testable criteria, risk tiers, and non-functional requirements defined up front, so engineers build against a clear contract. 
Own and evolve the test automation architecture and tooling — engineers write the tests; you own the frameworks, pattern libraries, and standards they build against, and you keep them fit for a growing platform. 
Drive production health across platforms — review production signals on a regular cadence, monitor NFR compliance, track bugs and escalations by platform and severity, and make feature health scores available and trustworthy for every new feature. 
Lead incident response from a quality lens — you hold independent authority to declare an escalation without waiting for approval, drive root-cause analysis, and close the loop by updating contracts so the same gap doesn't reappear. 
Configure and maintain AI-assisted quality pipelines across the delivery lifecycle — from solution-document and AC review through test generation, PR risk scoring, and production signal analysis. 

We're Looking For People Who Have

Proven experience managing QA Engineers — you've led a quality team, developed people, and set direction, not just delivered your own work. 
Command of our technology stack — you're comfortable and hands-on with Playwright, Node.js, TypeScript, MongoDB, and Postgres. 
Fluency with AI-assisted engineering — you know your way around Claude Code and can set up agents and skills to compress manual effort and raise coverage. 
Deep, senior-level automation expertise — you're hands-on and credible in writing automation tests against the stack above. 
A track record of owning test architecture and contracts — acceptance criteria, risk tiers, NFRs, and the frameworks engineers build against. 
Strong production-health instincts — comfort with monitoring, signal review, incident response, and turning production patterns into better coverage. 
The judgment to know when to escalate and the confidence to make that call independently. 
A builder's mindset — you scale quality through systems, standards, and people rather than personal throughput. 
Preferred: exposure to AI-assisted quality tooling, mutation testing, and observability stacks (e.g., Datadog, Grafana, OpenTelemetry), and experience owning quality across multiple products or platforms at once. 

Pssst… you don't have to check all the boxes to apply!

The Benefits Of Working At Harver

As a global company, our benefits vary by location. Ask your recruiter to provide information about localized benefits. Harverians enjoy:

A competitive base salary and great incentive program
Paid time off — when you need it, take it
Benefit plan options that give you the flexibility to select the right health care coverage for you and eligible family members
Bonus opportunities and employee referral rewards

We werken met innovatieve en complexe ICT-infrastructuren.

Jij gaat aan de slag binnen de afdeling ICT OI van DUO ICT. Dit is een afdeling van zo’n honderdvijftien ICT professionals. Bij de Dienst Uitvoering Onderwijs (DUO) werk jij aan momenten die ertoe doen. Denk aan het starten met een studie, slagen voor een examen of het behalen van een diploma dat telt. Grote kans dat je ons al kent van één van die stappen.

Ook helpen we onderwijsinstellingen bij het uitwisselen van gegevens, het werken met onze systemen en het regelen van de financiering van onderwijs.

In ons werk denken we steeds vanuit de mensen die onze diensten gebruiken. We zorgen voor duidelijke informatie en betrouwbare dienstverlening, zodat mensen verder kunnen met hun studie, werk of toekomst.

een afgeronde HBO-opleiding gericht op informatica, dierhouderij of agrarisch ondernemerschap;

Wij bieden

werktijden die in overleg kunnen worden vastgesteld, zodat een optimale balans tussen werk en privé mogelijk is; 
sabbatical leave, studieverlof en deels betaald ouderschapverlof; 
er is veel aandacht voor vitaliteit en je kan, tegen een aantrekkelijk tarief, gebruik maken van de op de campus aanwezige sportfaciliteiten;

Je werkt op de groenste en meest innovatieve campus van Nederland, in een internationale en open werksfeer.
